official: 足立区中高層建築物等の建築に係る紛争の予防及び調整条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 特定用途建築物の説明対象を拡大
summary: 条例第6条第1項は、中高層建築物等の建築に関する説明の対象者を定めています。この改正で、規則で定める特定用途建築物の場合は、近隣関係住民も説明対象に加わります。令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 特定用途建築物に該当する場合の説明対象者を広げる
who: 特定用途建築物の近隣関係住民
why: 中高層建築物等の建築に関する説明の対象者を改めるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Expands who must be informed about buildings with specified uses
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Adachi City Ordinance on the Prevention and Adjustment of Disputes Related to the Construction of Mid- and High-Rise Buildings, etc.
en.summary: Article 6, paragraph 1 of the ordinance sets out who must receive explanations about the construction of mid- and high-rise buildings, etc. Under this amendment, nearby residents will also be included when the building is one with a specified use as set out in the rules. The amendment takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Adds nearby residents to those who must receive explanations when a building has a specified use
who: Nearby residents of buildings with specified uses
en.why: The ward says this is to revise who must receive explanations about the construction of mid- and high-rise buildings, etc.
